overview: Lossless join aur dependency preservation; non-preserving par constraint check ke liye join.
coreConcept: Lossless join aur dependency preservation; non-preserving par constraint check ke liye join.
hinglishExplanation: Lossless iff R1 n R2 -> R1 ya R2. Dependency preserved iff FDs union of projections se imply ho.
formalDefinition: Lossless join aur dependency preservation; non-preserving par constraint check ke liye join.
importantProperties: Lossless: common attrs key of R1 or R2.
Not dependency preserving => FD check ke liye join karna padta hai.
BCNF lossless par dependency preserving nahi guarantee.
